Parliamentary Pensions (Repeal) 3
Act, No. 5 of 2026
[Certified on 17th of February, 2026]
L.D.-O 31/2025
An Act to repeal the Parliamentary Pensions
Law, No. 1 of 1977
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This Act may be cited as the Parliamentary Pensions Short title
(Repeal) Act, No. 5 of 2026.
2. The Parliamentary Pensions Law, No. 1 of 1977 is Repeal of the Law,
hereby repealed. No. 1 of 1977
3. For the avoidance of doubt, it is hereby declared that Avoidance of
doubt
any person who is entitled to receive a pension in terms of
the provisions of the Parliamentary Pensions Law, No. 1 of
1977, section 9 of Act, No. 1 of 1982 or section 9 of Act,
No. 47 of 1990, and is in receipt of a pension under the
aforesaid provisions preceding the date of commencement
of this Act, shall, on and after the date of commencement of
this Act, cease to receive such pension.
4. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala Sinhala text to
prevail in case of
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
